_comment: Eleven-slot set for the 1.7 page: the eight live 1.2 slots plus Airplane Mode, Open skies and Customs. Same schema and the same `default` block as screenshots-1.2.json (fastlane frameit's Framefile.json shape), so the captions match the live set exactly. Slots built from the eight 1.2 sources are copied byte for byte from AppStore/screenshots-1.2/ (the QA/ captures behind them have since been retaken), so only slots 2, 7 and 8 are rendered: python3 scripts/make_app_store_screenshots.py --config AppStore/screenshots-1.7.json --out AppStore/screenshots-1.7 --slots 2,7,8. Sources for those three: mk-17 from VoyageUITests/AirplaneModeCaptureUITests.swift, mk-18 from OpenSkiesCaptureUITests (02-inflight-nearest-field), mk-19 from CustomsCaptureUITests (customs-1-asking), all on an iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator. App Store Connect accepts at most ten screenshots per display size, so one slot has to go before upload.
